result.topic_en: Gauss computes the total action (force components X, Y, Z) of electric fluids on corresponding surface elements of two surfaces I and II, transforms the X component into a sum of partial derivatives, and sets up its double integration over the projection of I onto the xy-plane.
result.transcription:

Die Gesammtwirkung derjenigen Fluida die
auf den einander entsprechenden Elementen von I u.
II [-verbr-] enthalten sind, werden demnach
$\frac{\varepsilon i k \zeta . \omega}{r^5}\left\{3xy.\left(\frac{dz}{dx}\right)+(3yy-rr)\left(\frac{dz}{dy}\right)-3yz\right\}=\partial X\omega$
$-\frac{\varepsilon i k \zeta . \omega}{r^5}\left\{(3xx-rr)\left(\frac{dz}{dx}\right)+3xy\left(\frac{dz}{dy}\right)-3xz\right\}=\partial Y\omega$
$0 \qquad = Z\omega$
Fangen wir nun mit der Umformung von $\overset{\omega}{X}$ an, welches wir
zuerst in die Form setzen
$\omega X=\frac{\varepsilon i k \zeta \omega}{r^5}\left\{3xy\left(\frac{\partial z}{dx}\right)+(2rr-3xx-3zz)\left(\frac{dz}{\partial y}\right)-3yz\right\}$
$=\frac{\varepsilon i k \zeta \omega}{r^5}\left\{\begin{array}{l}\left(x\frac{\partial\partial z}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{dy}\right)rr-3\left(x+z\left(\frac{dz}{dx}\right)\right)x.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\\-\left(x\frac{\partial\partial z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)rr+3\left(y+z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)\left(x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-z\right)\end{array}\right\}$
$=\varepsilon i k \zeta \omega\left\{\frac{\partial\frac{x\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)}{r^3}}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial\frac{x\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)-z}{r^3}}{\partial y}\right\}$
